400.title: Oil-Rich Azerbaijan Bets Big on a Clean Energy Boom
400.summary: In March 2025, the World Bank approved the Azerbaijan Scaling-Up Renewable Energy Project AZURE, which aims to strengthen Azerbaijan's power transmission network, support energy diversification, and meet the country's growing energy demand.
400.body: Natural gas contributed 67 per cent of Azerbaijan's energy supply in 2023, while oil and oil products accounted for 31.1% and hydropower and other renewable energy sources contributed less than 2 per cent of the energy mix. In March 2025, the World Bank approved the Azerbaijan Scaling-Up Renewable Energy Project AZURE, which aims to strengthen Azerbaijan's power transmission network, support energy diversification, and meet the country's growing energy demand. Amin Mammadov, Deputy Chairman of the Public Council under the Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources, explained, "Azerbaijan has been an energy hub for a very long time We want to also do that for green energy." The three main routes of focus are the Caspian-Black Sea-Europe Corridor, the Azerbaijan-Trkiye-Europe Corridor, and the Central Asia-Azerbaijan-Europe Corridor.

600.title: International federation president: "We want to help develop Karabakh as a sports destination" – İDMAN.BİZ FROM POLAND
600.summary: In an interview with İdman.Biz , Konietzko spoke about plans to stage international tournaments in Azerbaijan, develop Mingachevir as a training centre and expand paddle sports in Karabakh. – We are at the World Championships.
600.body: In an interview with İdman.Biz , Konietzko spoke about plans to stage international tournaments in Azerbaijan, develop Mingachevir as a training centre and expand paddle sports in Karabakh. – We are at the World Championships. This region deserves it, and we want to help your country develop it as a sports destination. – Is there already an indication of when the first international paddle sports competition could be held in Karabakh? – Not yet, but a visit by specialists to the venue will take place in October. Invest in youth and junior athletes, and one day you will have elite-level paddlers capable of fighting for podium places. – Is Azerbaijan being considered not only as a host for international competitions but also as a training and development centre for athletes? – Mingachevir has a history of hosting winter training camps dating back to the Soviet era.
